release_notes.title: Batch Image Foundry · Local Skill / Web 0.2.2 (1091)
release_notes.summary:
Local Skill + complete browser workbench. One frozen Web build, with matching standalone Python and Provider materials. No desktop App, WebView or developer environment is needed. Projects and account state stay on the user computer; the listener is loopback only.

Mac arm64: the final archive was unpacked under a path containing spaces and Chinese text; standalone launch, project navigation, real browser edits read back through the packaged CLI, active-page safe-stop refusal, safe close and saved project reopening after backend restart passed.
Windows x64: locked Python/wheel/Provider materials, ZIP integrity, binary target and identical Web hashes were checked on macOS. Actual Windows execution and browser acceptance remain unverified. No new online image generation was run.

Preview release. This local archive currently uses complete directory replacement after safe runtime retirement; external projects and authorization remain in place. It does not inherit desktop EXE/DMG updates. Desktop installers retain their existing version and channels. Linux and mobile complete local runtimes are not part of this release.

The final 1091 archives use portable name/description Skill frontmatter and pass the installed host's Skill format validator. Their program and Web files exactly match the real browser acceptance build; only the consumer Skill and build-identity records changed. Final Mac bundled cold startup, original command use, safe stop and saved project reopening also passed.
